_about: Clean display values for the 12 Jyotirlinga page, distilled from data/jyotirlinga.json (research, sources + as_of 2026-10-08). 'confirm' = no official source found; shown as approximate.

somnath-jyotirlinga.tip: Phones, cameras and smartwatches are not allowed inside — free lockers at the gate. Book rooms and pujas only on somnath.org.

mallikarjuna-jyotirlinga.hours: Darshan slots from about 4:30 am to 8:30 pm (confirm on the temple portal)
mallikarjuna-jyotirlinga.tip: Srisailam is also a Shakti Peeth — Bhramaramba Devi. Kartika month and Mahashivratri bring very large crowds.

mahakaleshwar-jyotirlinga.hours: From about 4 am to 11 pm (confirm locally)
mahakaleshwar-jyotirlinga.aarti: Bhasma Aarti from 4 am — advance booking needed
mahakaleshwar-jyotirlinga.tip: Book the Bhasma Aarti on the temple website about a month ahead; since June 2026 one booking per mobile number every 90 days. Dhoti for men and saree for women in the inner sanctum.

omkareshwar-jyotirlinga.hours: Darshan 5 am – 10:30 pm, with breaks for aarti and shringar
omkareshwar-jyotirlinga.aarti: Mangala aarti 4:30 am; evening shringar 4 pm
omkareshwar-jyotirlinga.tip: Most pilgrims visit both Omkareshwar on Mandhata island and Mamleshwar (Amaleshwar) on the south bank of the Narmada.

kedarnath-jyotirlinga.hours: Seasonal; daily hours not published by the temple committee
kedarnath-jyotirlinga.air: Jolly Grant, Dehradun (about 240 km to Gaurikund)
kedarnath-jyotirlinga.season: Opened 22 Apr 2026; closes around Bhai Dooj (Nov)
kedarnath-jyotirlinga.tip: Char Dham registration is compulsory. Walk about 16 km from Gaurikund, or go by pony, palki or helicopter — helicopter tickets only on heliyatra.irctc.co.in.

bhimashankar-jyotirlinga.hours: Confirm locally — the temple reopened in June 2026 with online passes
bhimashankar-jyotirlinga.season: All year (closed 9 Jan – 14 Jun 2026 for works)
bhimashankar-jyotirlinga.tip: Ghat roads are foggy and slippery in the monsoon. Check whether an online darshan pass is needed before you go.

kashi-vishwanath-jyotirlinga.tip: Enter from Gate 1 for the Mangala aarti. Dev Deepawali and Mahashivratri are the most crowded days.

trimbakeshwar-jyotirlinga.aarti: Morning puja 7 am; mid-day puja 10:45 am
trimbakeshwar-jyotirlinga.tip: The source of the Godavari is on Brahmagiri above the temple. Expect huge crowds on the 2027 Simhastha Kumbh bathing days.

vaidyanath-jyotirlinga.aarti: Doors open 4 am; shringar puja 6:10 pm
vaidyanath-jyotirlinga.tip: Shravan (Jul–Aug) is the great Kanwar season, when pilgrims carry Ganga water from Sultanganj — very crowded.

nageshwar-jyotirlinga.tip: Visit with the Dwarkadhish temple and Bet Dwarka on the same day.

rameshwaram-jyotirlinga.tip: Pilgrims bathe in the 22 theerthams (wells) inside the temple before darshan — carry a change of clothes.

grishneshwar-jyotirlinga.tip: It stands next to the Ellora Caves — plan them together.
